passages.text: This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
passages.note: strength that does not come from force or power

passages.text: Indeed, who despises the day of small things?
passages.note: valuing small beginnings and modest progress

passages.text: Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother. Don’t oppress the widow, nor the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
passages.note: kindness, compassion and fairness toward others
